**Applied 4 doc/i18n fixes from adversarial review of issue-214 branch**

What: Applied 4 targeted doc/i18n fixes on branch feat/issue-214-secret-scrub-idintegrity found by adversarial review (m2, m3, m4 x2, m4b): (1) i18n secretFound hint in en.mjs/es.mjs — added `gunzip -c {file} | jq .` inspect tip; (2) design.md issue-214 Decision 2 — added paragraph on over-broad allowlist patterns silently disabling the gate, human review as sole backstop; (3) renamed stale `index.json` -> `index.jsonl` refs describing CURRENT contract in issue-205 proposal.md (1 line), issue-201 design.md (1 bullet, rationale also corrected from "splice two JSON objects" to "duplicate/stale entries from line-based union of independently-regenerated snapshots"), and issue-201 spec.md (full-file replace_all, 17 occurrences, verified all present-tense normative REQ-MF-4 contract language, no historical narration found — safe); (4) removed dangling "framing below was stale" -> "framing (now removed) was stale" in memory-format.md and adr-0017-memory-format-owned-by-brain.md brain-drafts.

Why: Adversarial review of the branch (after issue-214 C1b implementation) flagged these as doc/i18n-only issues, no production code changes.

Where: brain/scripts/i18n/{en,es}.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-214-secret-scrub-idintegrity/design.md; openspec/changes/issue-205-memory-format-lib/proposal.md; openspec/changes/issue-201-memory-format/{design.md,spec.md}; openspec/changes/issue-201-memory-format/brain-drafts/{memory-format.md,adr-0017-memory-format-owned-by-brain.md}.

Learned: memory-format.md and adr-0017-memory-format-owned-by-brain.md already had large pre-existing uncommitted diffs (index.json->jsonl renames, date/header amendments) from the branch's own issue-214 implementation work BEFORE this task started — git diff on those two files shows much more than my edit, but my Edit tool call only touched the exact "framing below was stale" phrase; verified via the tool's old_string match. No ambiguous historical-vs-current judgment calls arose in issue-201/spec.md — the whole file is present-tense normative REQ-MF-4 contract prose, safe for a full replace_all. All three gates (npm test — 953/953 pass, npm run brain:repo:check, npm run brain:nav) passed clean after the edits with no further fixes needed.
